variants.asks: two of the SAME thing, closer than a wavelength. Does the averaging that gave one half still apply to them?
variants.about: share, for two of the same

probes.asks: what are this lattice's own numbers - how many ways out of a point, how many charges a pulse lets go, how long a turn takes?
probes.found: fcc-12: D = 3, DEG = 12, SHEET = 6, CYCLE = 6 - counts, not measurements

measured.name: DEG
measured.note: the ways out of a point on fcc-12 - the exits it has, counted

measured.name: SHEET
measured.note: the exits with no component along the pulsing axis, which is what a source emits over. NOT DEG, which is 12

measured.name: CYCLE
measured.note: how many steps go round the ring of a turn on fcc-12

measured.name: slice
measured.note: a turn sweeps a PLANE, and a plane needs two dimensions - so what a turn lives in is min(D, 2), which is 2 here and stops growing at 2 however many dimensions are added

measured.name: \bar{c}
measured.note: a step's worth of lean is what one annihilation buys a path, and a step is \bar{c} - one cell a tick, the lattice's own speed. Its value in those units is one, which is a statement about the units and not about the quantity

steps.id: equals(share, for two of the same)=1*1
steps.because: the half in share.coherence came from averaging |ψ|/π over a phase difference that was anybody's guess. Two of the same thing pulse at the same rate, so their phase difference is not anybody's guess - there is nothing left to average, and what would have been averaged down is not

steps.id: value(share, for two of the same)
steps.because: 1 has nothing left in it that varies, so it is 1 exactly
from: equals(share, for two of the same)=1*1

share, for two of the same.says: how opposed two of the same thing are

share.says: the averaged value, for things whose phases are anybody's guess

m.says: its mass, which is that rate
